Sit your hips back slightly so your knees are bent
Walk backwards with small steps, pushing through the front of each foot
Keep tension on the strap the whole way, no jerking
backward-sled-drag.mistake: Leaning back and pulling with the arms — the quads should do the work

steps: Stand a foot from the box, feet hip-width
Swing your arms back and dip into a quarter squat
Jump up and land softly with your whole foot on the box, knees over toes
Stand tall, then step down one foot at a time
box-jump.mistake: Jumping down off the box — step down to spare the tendons

steps: Hold the ball at your chest, facing the wall about an arm's length away
Squat until your hips are below your knees, chest up
Drive up and throw the ball to the target in one movement
Catch it high and sink straight into the next squat
wall-ball.mistake: Throwing with the arms only — the throw should come from the legs

steps: Pick up one kettlebell at your side like a suitcase
Brace your core and stand tall with shoulders level
Walk with steady, normal steps for the distance
Switch hands and walk back
suitcase-carry.mistake: Leaning away from or toward the bell — the point is to stay upright
